This one is the guess: the thread says "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two only because Moss's digest says the dealer account changed hands on 5 Jan. I told Pree to double-check it.
4. PD-5302, from #central-random on 14 Oct. Hollis posted it as another Marrow Fieldworks ticket, a follow-up from this week, with no action needed.

No other Marrow Fieldworks tickets came up this week in the channels Pree belongs to. I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they are for Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. In my reply to her I wrote "(#central-team, June)" for PD-4821. I meant June 2026, but she might read it as June Osei-Lark.

I only read channels Pree is a member of and files anyone can open. I didn't use `search_messages`.
